basic_details.job_title: NRLM Karnataka Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NRLM Karnataka has listed 1 Office Assistant post for Kolar district (Taluka: ALL), with pay of 20000 as printed. Applicants need Any Graduation and 3+ years of experience in the relevant field, and the age range is 18 to 45 years. Applications are submitted by signing in on the job portal; the listing shows the opening date as 27 November 2026 and the closing date as 12 December 2026.

how_to_apply: The listing asks applicants to submit the application before the deadline by signing in on the job portal. It offers two routes: log in with an existing account, or create a free account. The notice names no documents, fee or other steps.
Open the Office Assistant listing for Kolar on the job portal.
Choose Sign In to Apply if you already have an account, or Create an Account to register free.
Submit the application on or before 12 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Office Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Online, by signing in on the job portal

content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka
content_sections.text: The listing places this post under NRLM Karnataka, for Kolar district. The Office Assistant works under the supervision of the District Level officer (DPM/DM) and, at Taluka Level, the TPM/CS, and the post is open for all talukas of the district.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Any Graduation. Experience: 3+ Years of Experience in relevant field. Age: minimum 18 years, maximum 45 years. The notice prints no date for counting age and no age relaxation. The notice does not name any desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official portal for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Office Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: To work under the supervision and guidance of DPM/DM at District Level and TPM/CS at Taluka Level. To work in close co-ordination with DPM/DM/TPM in implementing the activities and reaching the assigned targets. To ensure clean data entered into MIS. To assist in movement of files in time. To maintain files and reports. To co-ordinate with Officers at District Level and Taluk Level for any compliance required. Any other tasks as assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NRLM Karnataka Office Assistant
content_sections.text: The listing asks applicants to submit the application before the deadline by signing in on the job portal. It offers two routes: log in with an existing account, or create a free account. The notice names no documents, fee or other steps. Open the Office Assistant listing for Kolar on the job portal. Choose Sign In to Apply if you already have an account, or Create an Account to register free. Submit the application on or before 12 December 2026.
